description_detailed: In 2025, to mark the 75th anniversary of Peanuts, Monnaie de Paris celebrates the famous gang of friends. Snoopy is the main character of the collection and decides to cross the Atlantic ocean to travel to France for his birthday.The front of this coin features the Peanuts gang celebrating their birthday. In the foreground, Snoopy is hugging Woodstock. Both are wearing pointy hats. A gift wrapped in a ribbon is placed in front of Snoopy. Behind them, Charlie Brown, Lucy, Schroeder, Peppermint Patty, Sally and Marcie are all looking cheerful. Above their heads are the words ‘Happy Birthday! Joyeux anniversaire !' Shaped confetti surrounds the characters, showing that the mood is festive.The reverse of this coin shows the denomination surrounded by two branches, one of oak and the other of laurel, evoking the Euro symbol. The entire motif on the reverse is framed by ‘République Française’ and a series of lines representing the Hexagon.
